**Key Expectations**
* Own overall performance of the team and ensure delivery of agreed client outcomes.
* Responsible and accountable to assist and meet Operations SLA for the client.
* Responsible for auditing for ongoing process on the client.
* Responsible to lead and drive clients facing mails and project on time within threshold with timely updates to stakeholder.
* Weekly connect with colleagues to ensure right expectation and accountability set for the colleague.
* Consistently meet or exceed internal and client Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Drive high standards of service delivery through effective planning, execution, and monitoring.
* Proactively manage risks, escalations, and mitigation plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery.
* Build a sustainable delivery model with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members to drive performance, engagement, and growth.


**Required Skills**
* Strong people management and leadership capabilities.
* Proven experience in operations and/or technology delivery environments.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
* Ability to plan, monitor, and optimize resources based on demand and business priorities.
* Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Effective communication and coaching skills.


**Role Description**
 The Senior Service Manager (SSM) is a working manager accountable for the overall performance of the team and its members. The role is responsible for delivering agreed client outcomes by leading, coaching, and managing teams, proactively engaging stakeholders, and ensuring consistent adherence to internal and client SLAs.
   

  

 The SSM oversees all aspects of delivery across operations and technology, including planning and managing work, empowering teams, monitoring progress, and acting as an escalation point for delivery risks. The role defines measurable success indicators, builds strong customer and client relationships, and ensures a sustainable delivery model that consistently meets contractual performance standards.
   

  

 The incumbent is responsible for resource planning, workload distribution, managing unplanned absenteeism, and ensuring all daily, weekly, and monthly deliverables are met. This includes leading daily huddles, conducting audits to ensure quality, maintaining updated SOPs and documentation, and providing signoff for errorfree processing.
   

  

 The SSM also plays a critical role in people management—conducting regular one\-on\-one discussions, leading performance reviews, providing coaching and mentoring, managing engagement and development, and improving overall team performance through cost\-effective quality improvement measures. Collaboration with peer managers and cross functional teams is essential to ensure seamless client delivery.

* Bachelor’s degree


**Experience:**

title: Team Lead
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bellway Realtech is a property and land advisory firm dedicated to helping individuals and investors find peaceful weekend homes and secure land investments away from city noise. The company specializes in farmhouses and land across India, focusing on clear\-titled, safe, and high\-potential assets suitable for luxury retreats and long\-term returns. Bellway Realtech emphasizes transparency over transactions, providing honest guidance and complete support through legal and documentation processes. In addition to farmhouses, the team also has strong expertise in commercial and residential spaces, giving clients diverse options tailored to their goals.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Team Lead role at Bellway Realtech is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Noida. The Team Lead will oversee a small team of sales and advisory professionals, guide daily operations, and ensure that client interactions reflect the company’s commitment to transparency and trust. Responsibilities include managing property inquiries, coordinating site visits, mentoring team members, monitoring performance metrics, and ensuring accurate documentation and legal compliance for transactions. The Team Lead is expected to set clear goals, resolve issues promptly, and uphold high service standards in all client\-facing activities.

* Experience leading teams in real estate, property advisory, or a related field, with strong people management and mentoring skills.
* Proficiency in sales, negotiation, and client relationship management, particularly in land, farmhouse, residential, or commercial property transactions.
* Ability to understand and work with legal documentation, property due diligence, and compliance processes, ensuring transparent and accurate paperwork.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present property options clearly and build long\-term trust with diverse clients.

* Solid organizational and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple deals, priorities, and team tasks efficiently.
* Working knowledge of local real estate markets and investment trends; prior experience with land or farmhouse projects is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Management, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Proficiency with standard office tools and CRM or sales tracking software to monitor leads, pipeline, and team performance.

title: Relationship Manager PSF chanel Bajaj Life
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bajaj Life Insurance is one of India’s fastest\-growing life insurance companies, offering a wide range of solutions including ULIPs, term insurance, retirement, and child plans to support long\-term financial security. With over 3\.47 crore policyholders, robust assets under management, a high claim settlement ratio, and strong solvency margins, the company emphasizes reliability and customer protection. Bajaj Life provides innovative products such as specialized term plans, systematic investment solutions, and flexible income options designed for diverse needs and life stages. A wide distribution network of branches, consultants, and banking partners, combined with digital platforms like WhatsApp services, ensures convenient access and customer\-first service. The organization fosters innovation and collaboration across its 27,000\+ employees and has been consistently recognized as a top employer and a leading digital insurance brand.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager – PSF Channel at Bajaj Life is a full\-time on\-site role based in Noida, focused on managing and growing business through the Partner/PSF (Partnership/Sales Force) channel. description:
Adobe India is on a breakout growth trajectory and is well positioned in the South Asia region to drive exponential business growth in the next few years.
   

  

 As the Account Manager for Adobe Digital Media, you will be responsible for accelerating the growth in the assigned Named Accounts for Digital Media portfolio (Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, Adobe Sign etc.). This is very much a blend of "Farming" and “Hunting” role. You will be a seasoned sales professional who can identify strategic business opportunities in the assigned Named Accounts and work collaboratively with the ecosystem including CSM, Solution Consultants, Strategic Development Team, BDRs, ISRs, Channel partners etc. to achieve the revenue targets and growth in the accounts. This role is instrumental in contributing to a robust sales culture and requires an enterprise growth vision, confident and influential person who can develop strong business relationships across the board.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Create, maintain and execute a business plan for the assigned accounts with goals and objectives, based on opportunity, customer needs, and Adobe's strategic direction.
* Meet or exceed quota targets and increase the wallet share in the assigned account.
* Develop effective and specific account plans.
* Ability to build C Level relationships with CxOs via value\-based selling involving return on investment analysis.
* Become a trusted advisor to customers by establishing and augmenting account relationships.
* Develop customer perspective to understands each customer’s business priorities, strategic growth plans, technology strategy and the competitive landscape in the account.

* Use and collaborate with business functions including Marketing, CSM, License Advisory, Inside sales, Partners and channels etc. to funnel pipeline into the assigned territory and drive growth in the assigned accounts.
* Advance and close sales opportunities \- through the successful execution of the sales strategy and roadmap.


**What you need to succeed:**
* Bachelor’s Degree and preferably an MBA from respected colleges in the country
* Minimum of 12/15 years of consultative sales experience including strategic selling, persuasion and negotiation
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience of selling software / could subscriptions to enterprise customers.
* Experience collaborating with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution\-based sales process.
* Demonstrated ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.
* Strong communication skills to synthesize complex issues and communicate into simple messages
* Willingness and ability to travel within your specified geographic region

**About the role** 




  





 You'll be the person who takes a signed client from "we just bought this" to "this is running and driving results." At JoyzAI, that means standing up their AI chatbot and AI calling agents end\-to\-end — building the knowledge base, configuring the agent's behaviour, wiring up the lead and CRM flows, and then staying with them so the product actually delivers.
 



  





 This is not a ticket\-closing role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You're technical enough to configure agents yourself, and human enough to make clients feel taken care of at every step. You delight customers by solving the real problem, not by marking a query "resolved."
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





**Onboarding \& agent setup** 



* Own new\-client onboarding from kickoff to go\-live: scope the use case, gather source material, and set clear delivery timelines.
* Build and structure knowledge bases from client content (websites, brochures, PDFs, FAQs) so the AI answers accurately and on\-brand.
* Configure AI chatbot and AI calling agents across the platform — Tasks, Access, Behaviour, and AI Config — including prompt design, conversation flows, guardrails, and tone (including Hinglish where needed).
* Set up CRM contact fields, ticket types, and automated workflows so leads and conversations route correctly.
* Configure voice agent call handling — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and WhatsApp follow\-ups for links and addresses.



  





**Integrations \& data flow** 



* Wire up lead pipelines — e.g. Meta lead forms → Joyz webhook, Google Sheets automations — and validate that phone/contact data lands clean and deduplicated.
* Coordinate WhatsApp Business API setup with clients (WABA, embedded signup, number provisioning) and troubleshoot access or restriction issues.

**Ongoing success** 



* Run demos, walkthroughs, and handover sessions so clients can self\-serve confidently.
